book.name: 考研词汇精选
book.description: 考研英语高频核心词汇，按记忆曲线科学复习

examples.text: abandon the plan halfway
examples.trans: 半途放弃计划

examples.text: They abandoned the search due to bad weather.
examples.trans: 他们因天气恶劣而放弃了搜寻。

examples.text: The children ran with abandon.
examples.trans: 孩子们尽情奔跑。

examples.text: abolish the slave trade
examples.trans: 废除奴隶贸易

examples.text: The new government abolished the unfair law.
examples.trans: 新政府废除了这项不公正的法律。

examples.text: Slavery was abolished in the nineteenth century.
examples.trans: 奴隶制在十九世纪被废除。

examples.text: achieve one's goal
examples.trans: 实现目标

examples.text: She worked hard to achieve her goal.
examples.trans: 她努力工作以实现目标。

examples.text: You will never achieve anything without effort.
examples.trans: 不努力你将一事无成。

examples.text: advocate educational reform
examples.trans: 提倡教育改革

examples.text: Many experts advocate a balanced diet.
examples.trans: 许多专家提倡均衡饮食。

examples.text: He is a strong advocate of free trade.
examples.trans: 他是自由贸易的坚定拥护者。

meanings.meaning: 模棱两可的，含糊不清的

examples.text: an ambiguous reply
examples.trans: 模棱两可的答复

examples.text: His ambiguous answer confused us all.
examples.trans: 他含糊的回答让我们都很困惑。

examples.text: The wording of the contract is ambiguous.
examples.trans: 这份合同的措辞模棱两可。

examples.text: anticipate future changes
examples.trans: 预见未来的变化

examples.text: We anticipate that sales will rise next year.
examples.trans: 我们预计明年销量会上升。

examples.text: She anticipated the question and prepared an answer.
examples.trans: 她预料到了这个问题并准备好了答案。

examples.text: benefit from the experience
examples.trans: 从经验中受益

examples.text: Regular exercise benefits your health.
examples.trans: 经常锻炼有益健康。

examples.text: The new policy will benefit millions of people.
examples.trans: 新政策将使数百万人受益。

examples.text: be bewildered by the rules
examples.trans: 被规则弄得不知所措

examples.text: The sudden change bewildered the old man.
examples.trans: 突然的变化使老人不知所措。

examples.text: She was bewildered by the complicated map.
examples.trans: 她被复杂的地图弄糊涂了。

meanings.meaning: 受环境影响的，由情况决定的

examples.text: under no circumstances
examples.trans: 在任何情况下都不

examples.text: We cannot control every circumstance.
examples.trans: 我们无法控制所有情况。

examples.text: Under no circumstances should you give up.
examples.trans: 无论如何你都不应该放弃。

examples.text: commit a serious mistake
examples.trans: 犯严重错误

examples.text: He committed a serious mistake.
examples.trans: 他犯了一个严重错误。

examples.text: The government committed itself to cutting taxes.
examples.trans: 政府承诺减税。

examples.text: a comprehensive report
examples.trans: 一份全面的报告

examples.text: The book gives a comprehensive introduction to the city.
examples.trans: 这本书对该城市作了全面的介绍。

examples.text: We need a comprehensive plan to solve the problem.
examples.trans: 我们需要一个全面的计划来解决这个问题。

examples.text: condemn the violent act
examples.trans: 谴责暴力行为

examples.text: World leaders condemned the terrorist attack.
examples.trans: 世界各国领导人谴责了这起恐怖袭击。

examples.text: He was condemned to ten years in prison.
examples.trans: 他被判处十年监禁。

examples.text: contradict one's statement
examples.trans: 反驳某人的说法

examples.text: The two reports contradict each other.
examples.trans: 这两份报告相互矛盾。

examples.text: Don't contradict your boss in public.
examples.trans: 不要当众反驳你的上司。

examples.text: dedicate oneself to science
examples.trans: 献身于科学

examples.text: She dedicated her life to medical research.
examples.trans: 她一生致力于医学研究。

examples.text: He dedicated the book to his mother.
examples.trans: 他把这本书献给他的母亲。

examples.text: derive pleasure from reading
examples.trans: 从阅读中获得乐趣

examples.text: We derive pleasure from reading.
examples.trans: 我们从阅读中获得乐趣。

examples.text: The word derives from ancient Greek.
examples.trans: 这个词源于古希腊语。

examples.text: deteriorating health
examples.trans: 不断恶化的健康

examples.text: His health deteriorated rapidly last winter.
examples.trans: 去年冬天他的健康状况迅速恶化。

examples.text: Relations between the two countries deteriorated.
examples.trans: 两国关系恶化了。

examples.text: face a moral dilemma
examples.trans: 面临道德困境

examples.text: She was in a dilemma about the job offer.
examples.trans: 她对这份工作邀请左右为难。

examples.text: The doctor faced an ethical dilemma.
examples.trans: 这位医生面临伦理上的两难境地。

meanings.meaning: 有辨别力的，眼光敏锐的

examples.text: discern right from wrong
examples.trans: 分辨是非

examples.text: It is hard to discern the truth from the rumor.
examples.trans: 很难从谣言中辨别真相。

examples.text: I could barely discern the shape in the fog.
examples.trans: 我几乎看不清雾中的那个形状。

examples.text: make every endeavor
examples.trans: 竭尽全力

examples.text: We must endeavor to finish the task on time.
examples.trans: 我们必须努力按时完成任务。

examples.text: Scientific endeavor requires patience and curiosity.
examples.trans: 科学探索需要耐心和好奇心。

examples.text: the essence of democracy
examples.trans: 民主的本质

examples.text: Time is of the essence in an emergency.
examples.trans: 紧急情况下时间至关重要。

examples.text: The essence of his argument is quite simple.
examples.trans: 他的论点实质很简单。

examples.text: evaluate students' progress
examples.trans: 评估学生的进步

examples.text: Teachers evaluate students' progress.
examples.trans: 老师评估学生的进步。

examples.text: We need to evaluate the risks before investing.
examples.trans: 投资前我们需要评估风险。

examples.text: self-evident truth
examples.trans: 不言而喻的真理

examples.text: It was evident that she was tired.
examples.trans: 显然她累了。

examples.text: The damage was evident after the storm.
examples.trans: 暴风雨过后损失显而易见。

examples.text: exaggerate the danger
examples.trans: 夸大危险

examples.text: Don't exaggerate the difficulty of the exam.
examples.trans: 不要夸大考试的难度。

examples.text: He tends to exaggerate his own importance.
examples.trans: 他往往夸大自己的重要性。

examples.text: facilitate communication between teams
examples.trans: 促进团队间的交流

examples.text: The new software facilitates data analysis.
examples.trans: 新软件使数据分析变得便利。

examples.text: Good roads facilitate the transport of goods.
examples.trans: 良好的道路便利了货物运输。

examples.text: flourish in the new market
examples.trans: 在新市场蓬勃发展

examples.text: Business flourished after the reform.
examples.trans: 改革后生意兴隆。

examples.text: These plants flourish in warm climates.
examples.trans: 这些植物在温暖气候下长得茂盛。

examples.text: foster a spirit of cooperation
examples.trans: 培养合作精神

examples.text: The teacher fostered creativity in her students.
examples.trans: 这位老师培养了学生的创造力。

examples.text: They fostered two children from abroad.
examples.trans: 他们收养了两名外国儿童。

examples.text: furnish the office with desks
examples.trans: 给办公室配备桌子

examples.text: The flat is fully furnished.
examples.trans: 这套公寓配有全套家具。

examples.text: Please furnish us with the details.
examples.trans: 请向我们提供详细情况。

examples.text: genuine concern for others
examples.trans: 对他人真诚的关心

examples.text: She showed genuine concern for him.
examples.trans: 她对他表现出真诚的关心。

examples.text: The painting was proved to be genuine.
examples.trans: 这幅画被证明是真品。

examples.text: grasp the main idea
examples.trans: 抓住大意

examples.text: He quickly grasped the basic rules.
examples.trans: 他很快掌握了基本规则。

examples.text: The concept is beyond my grasp.
examples.trans: 这个概念超出我的理解能力。

examples.text: a health hazard
examples.trans: 健康隐患

examples.text: Smoking is a serious health hazard.
examples.trans: 吸烟是严重的健康危害。

examples.text: Firefighters face many hazards every day.
examples.trans: 消防员每天面临许多危险。

examples.text: hesitate to ask questions
examples.trans: 犹豫是否提问

examples.text: Don't hesitate to ask questions.
examples.trans: 不要犹豫，尽管提问。

examples.text: She hesitated before opening the door.
examples.trans: 她犹豫了一下才开门。

examples.text: highlight the main problems
examples.trans: 强调主要问题

examples.text: The report highlights the need for reform.
examples.trans: 报告强调了改革的必要性。

examples.text: The trip was the highlight of the year.
examples.trans: 这次旅行是这一年中最精彩的部分。

meanings.meaning: 暗示，意味着，含有……的意思

examples.text: imply agreement
examples.trans: 暗示同意

examples.text: His silence implied agreement.
examples.trans: 他的沉默表示同意。

examples.text: The data imply that the policy works.
examples.trans: 这些数据意味着该政策有效。

examples.text: offer tax incentives
examples.trans: 提供税收激励

examples.text: Bonuses are an incentive to work harder.
examples.trans: 奖金是激励人们更努力工作的手段。

examples.text: Tax cuts give companies an incentive to invest.
examples.trans: 减税给公司提供了投资的动力。

examples.text: an indispensable tool
examples.trans: 必不可少的工具

examples.text: Computers are indispensable in modern offices.
examples.trans: 计算机在现代办公室中不可或缺。

examples.text: Water is indispensable to all living things.
examples.trans: 水对所有生物都是不可缺少的。

examples.text: integrate theory with practice
examples.trans: 理论联系实际

examples.text: The app integrates maps with shopping services.
examples.trans: 这款应用将地图与购物服务整合在一起。

examples.text: Immigrants should be integrated into society.
examples.trans: 移民应该融入社会。

examples.text: an intricate design
examples.trans: 精细复杂的设计

examples.text: The watch has an intricate mechanism.
examples.trans: 这块手表有着精密复杂的机械结构。

examples.text: They discussed the intricate details of the plan.
examples.trans: 他们讨论了计划中错综复杂的细节。

examples.text: jeopardize one's career
examples.trans: 危及职业生涯

examples.text: The scandal jeopardized his political career.
examples.trans: 这一丑闻危及了他的政治生涯。

examples.text: Smoking jeopardizes your health.
examples.trans: 吸烟危害你的健康。

examples.text: justify the decision
examples.trans: 证明这个决定合理

examples.text: Nothing can justify such behavior.
examples.trans: 没有任何理由能为这种行为辩护。

examples.text: How can you justify spending so much money?
examples.trans: 你怎么能为花这么多钱辩解？

examples.text: a legitimate reason to complain
examples.trans: 正当的抱怨理由

examples.text: You have a legitimate reason to complain.
examples.trans: 你有正当理由抱怨。

examples.text: The company made a legitimate business deal.
examples.trans: 这家公司做了一笔合法的生意。

examples.text: linger in the memory
examples.trans: 萦绕在记忆中

examples.text: The smell of paint lingered in the room.
examples.trans: 房间里残留着油漆的气味。

examples.text: She lingered after class to ask a question.
examples.trans: 她课后留下来问了一个问题。

examples.text: maintain a healthy lifestyle
examples.trans: 保持健康的生活方式

examples.text: It is hard to maintain this lifestyle.
examples.trans: 维持这种生活方式很难。

examples.text: He maintained that he was innocent.
examples.trans: 他坚持说自己是无辜的。

examples.text: manifest one's dissatisfaction
examples.trans: 流露出不满

examples.text: Stress often manifests itself as illness.
examples.trans: 压力常以疾病的形式表现出来。

examples.text: It was manifest to all that the plan had failed.
examples.trans: 所有人都清楚计划失败了。

examples.text: mediate between the two sides
examples.trans: 在双方之间调解

examples.text: The UN mediated in the conflict.
examples.trans: 联合国在这场冲突中进行了调解。

examples.text: A lawyer helped mediate the dispute.
examples.trans: 一位律师帮助调解了这起纠纷。

examples.text: negotiate a new contract
examples.trans: 商定一份新合同

examples.text: They negotiated a new contract.
examples.trans: 他们谈妥了一份新合同。

examples.text: The two sides agreed to negotiate on prices.
examples.trans: 双方同意就价格进行谈判。

meanings.meaning: 臭名昭著的，声名狼藉的

examples.text: a notorious criminal
examples.trans: 一个臭名昭著的罪犯

examples.text: The area is notorious for heavy traffic.
examples.trans: 这个地区因交通拥堵而出名。

examples.text: He is a notorious liar in the office.
examples.trans: 他是办公室里出了名的撒谎者。

examples.text: nourish the soil
examples.trans: 滋养土壤

examples.text: Good books nourish the mind.
examples.trans: 好书滋养心灵。

examples.text: Mother's milk nourishes the baby.
examples.trans: 母乳滋养婴儿。

examples.text: a sense of obligation
examples.trans: 责任感

examples.text: Parents have a legal obligation to educate their children.
examples.trans: 父母有教育子女的法律义务。

examples.text: I feel under no obligation to help him.
examples.trans: 我觉得没有义务帮助他。

examples.text: overcome the main obstacle
examples.trans: 克服主要障碍

examples.text: Money was the main obstacle.
examples.trans: 钱是主要的障碍。

examples.text: Fear of failure is the biggest obstacle to success.
examples.trans: 对失败的恐惧是成功的最大障碍。

examples.text: offset the carbon emissions
examples.trans: 抵消碳排放

examples.text: Higher wages were offset by rising prices.
examples.trans: 上涨的物价抵消了增加的工资。

examples.text: The losses were offset by gains elsewhere.
examples.trans: 损失被其他方面的收益抵消了。

examples.text: be overwhelmed by work
examples.trans: 被工作压得喘不过气

examples.text: She was overwhelmed by the flood of information.
examples.trans: 她被大量信息弄得不知所措。

examples.text: The army overwhelmed the enemy forces.
examples.trans: 军队击垮了敌军。

meanings.meaning: 自相矛盾的，似非而是的

examples.text: a curious paradox
examples.trans: 一个奇怪的悖论

examples.text: It is a paradox that busy people find more time.
examples.trans: 忙碌的人反而有更多时间，这真是个悖论。

examples.text: The story is full of paradox.
examples.trans: 这个故事充满悖论。

examples.text: participate in the discussion
examples.trans: 参与讨论

examples.text: Everyone is free to participate.
examples.trans: 每个人都可以自由参加。

examples.text: All students are encouraged to participate in sports.
examples.trans: 鼓励所有学生参加体育运动。

examples.text: perceive a change in attitude
examples.trans: 察觉态度的变化

examples.text: Children often perceive the world differently.
examples.trans: 儿童对世界的感知常常不同。

examples.text: I perceived a slight change in her voice.
examples.trans: 我察觉到她的声音有细微变化。

examples.text: prevail over difficulties
examples.trans: 战胜困难

examples.text: Justice will prevail in the end.
examples.trans: 正义终将获胜。

examples.text: This custom still prevails in rural areas.
examples.trans: 这一习俗在农村地区仍然盛行。

examples.text: provoke a violent reaction
examples.trans: 引起强烈反应

examples.text: His rude remarks provoked an angry response.
examples.trans: 他粗鲁的言论激起了愤怒的回应。

examples.text: Don't provoke the dog; it may bite.
examples.trans: 不要惹那只狗，它可能会咬人。

examples.text: qualify for the scholarship
examples.trans: 获得奖学金资格

examples.text: She qualified for the scholarship.
examples.trans: 她获得了奖学金资格。

examples.text: His experience qualifies him for the post.
examples.trans: 他的经验使他有资格担任这一职务。

examples.text: refute an argument
examples.trans: 驳斥一个论点

examples.text: The scientist refuted the false claim with data.
examples.trans: 这位科学家用数据驳斥了错误的主张。

examples.text: She refuted his accusation calmly.
examples.trans: 她平静地驳斥了他的指责。

examples.text: be reluctant to leave
examples.trans: 不愿离开

examples.text: He was reluctant to leave.
examples.trans: 他不愿离开。

examples.text: She gave a reluctant yes to the plan.
examples.trans: 她勉强同意了这个计划。

examples.text: restrain one's anger
examples.trans: 克制怒火

examples.text: He could hardly restrain his anger.
examples.trans: 他几乎抑制不住怒火。

examples.text: New laws restrain the power of the press.
examples.trans: 新法律约束了新闻界的权力。

examples.text: rigid rules
examples.trans: 死板的规定

examples.text: The school has rigid rules about uniforms.
examples.trans: 这所学校对校服有严格的规定。

examples.text: His rigid attitude annoyed everyone.
examples.trans: 他刻板的态度让所有人恼火。

meanings.meaning: 重要的，显著的，有意义的

examples.text: a significant improvement
examples.trans: 显著的提高

examples.text: There was a significant improvement.
examples.trans: 有了显著的提高。

examples.text: This is a significant step towards peace.
examples.trans: 这是迈向和平的重要一步。

examples.text: be skeptical about the claim
examples.trans: 对这一说法持怀疑态度

examples.text: Many scientists are skeptical about the new theory.
examples.trans: 许多科学家对新理论持怀疑态度。

examples.text: I am skeptical of his promises.
examples.trans: 我对他的承诺持怀疑态度。

meanings.meaning: 自发的，自然的，非勉强的

examples.text: spontaneous applause
examples.trans: 自发的掌声

examples.text: The crowd burst into spontaneous applause.
examples.trans: 人群爆发出自发的掌声。

examples.text: Their meeting was completely spontaneous.
examples.trans: 他们的相遇完全是偶然的、自发的。

examples.text: sufficient evidence
examples.trans: 充分的证据

examples.text: We have sufficient food for the trip.
examples.trans: 我们有足够的旅行食物。

examples.text: There is sufficient evidence to support the claim.
examples.trans: 有充分的证据支持这一说法。

meanings.meaning: 易受影响的，敏感的，易患……的

examples.text: be susceptible to colds
examples.trans: 容易感冒

examples.text: Children are susceptible to bad influences.
examples.trans: 儿童容易受到不良影响。

examples.text: Elderly people are particularly susceptible to the disease.
examples.trans: 老年人尤其容易患这种疾病。

meanings.meaning: 试探性的，暂定的，犹豫的

examples.text: a tentative plan
examples.trans: 一个初步的计划

examples.text: We reached a tentative agreement last week.
examples.trans: 上周我们达成了初步协议。

examples.text: The first steps were cautious and tentative.
examples.trans: 最初的几步小心而试探。

examples.text: tolerate the noise
examples.trans: 容忍噪音

examples.text: I cannot tolerate this noise.
examples.trans: 我受不了这噪音。

examples.text: The school does not tolerate cheating.
examples.trans: 这所学校不容忍作弊行为。

examples.text: transmit the virus
examples.trans: 传播病毒

examples.text: Mosquitoes can transmit the disease.
examples.trans: 蚊子能传播这种疾病。

examples.text: The message was transmitted by satellite.
examples.trans: 这一信息通过卫星传送。

examples.text: trigger an economic crisis
examples.trans: 引发经济危机

examples.text: The news triggered a heated debate.
examples.trans: 这一消息引发了激烈的辩论。

examples.text: Smoke triggers the fire alarm.
examples.trans: 烟雾会触发火警报警器。

meanings.meaning: 不能的，不会的，无能力的

examples.text: be unable to reach the apple
examples.trans: 够不着苹果

examples.text: The boy is unable to reach the apple.
examples.trans: 男孩够不着苹果。

examples.text: He was unable to attend the meeting.
examples.trans: 他未能参加会议。

examples.text: the ultimate goal
examples.trans: 最终目标

examples.text: Their ultimate goal is to win the championship.
examples.trans: 他们的最终目标是赢得冠军。

examples.text: The ultimate decision rests with the manager.
examples.trans: 最终决定权在经理手里。

examples.text: undergo an operation
examples.trans: 接受手术

examples.text: The old bridge must undergo safety checks.
examples.trans: 这座老桥必须接受安全检查。

examples.text: She underwent intensive training last year.
examples.trans: 她去年接受了强化训练。

examples.text: underestimate the cost
examples.trans: 低估成本

examples.text: Never underestimate your opponent.
examples.trans: 永远不要低估你的对手。

examples.text: The company underestimated the demand for its product.
examples.trans: 这家公司低估了其产品的需求。

meanings.meaning: 有效的，有根据的，合法的

examples.text: a valid passport
examples.trans: 一本有效的护照

examples.text: Your ticket is valid for three months.
examples.trans: 你的票三个月内有效。

examples.text: She raised a valid point at the meeting.
examples.trans: 她在会上提出了一个有根据的观点。

examples.text: influenza vaccine
examples.trans: 流感疫苗

examples.text: The vaccine protects against the virus.
examples.trans: 这种疫苗能抵抗病毒。

examples.text: verify the information
examples.trans: 核实信息

examples.text: Please verify your email address.
examples.trans: 请核实您的电子邮件地址。

examples.text: Scientists verified the results through repeated tests.
examples.trans: 科学家通过反复实验核实了结果。

examples.text: vigorous exercise
examples.trans: 剧烈运动

examples.text: Regular vigorous exercise keeps you healthy.
examples.trans: 经常进行剧烈运动能保持健康。

examples.text: The government took vigorous action against crime.
examples.trans: 政府对犯罪采取了有力的行动。

examples.text: warrant further investigation
examples.trans: 有必要进一步调查

examples.text: The situation warrants immediate action.
examples.trans: 局势需要立即采取行动。

examples.text: Police obtained a search warrant from the court.
examples.trans: 警方获得了法院颁发的搜查令。

examples.text: wither in the drought
examples.trans: 在干旱中枯萎

examples.text: The crops withered for lack of rain.
examples.trans: 庄稼因缺少雨水而枯萎。

examples.text: The once booming industry began to wither.
examples.trans: 曾经繁荣的行业开始衰落。
